title: QSOL UFF v5.0.0: Reproducible Astrophysics and Falsification Laboratory
description:
QSOL UFF v5.0.0 is a transparent Python research laboratory spanning validated galaxy rotation-curve and compact-object analysis, preregistered catalogue-level celestial-node falsification through UFF-SLFA, and survey-aware adversarial evaluation through the Sheridan Crucible.

The software provides frozen machine-readable contracts, deterministic null models, survey masks and completeness handling, spherical von Mises-Fisher density reconstruction, nuisance-model comparison, synthetic injection calibration, SHA-256 evidence bundles, public-claim provenance, and deterministic numerical replay.

Scientific boundary: these controls establish computational consistency and calibrated catalogue-level tests. They do not establish a physical ontology or validate an extraordinary causal claim.
